learning_actions.title: Statistical Analysis of a Public Dataset
learning_actions.description: 1. Choose a public dataset from sources like Kaggle or UCI Machine Learning Repository. 2. Load the dataset using Pandas in Python. 3. learning_actions.title: Deploy a Web Application on AWS EC2
learning_actions.description: 1. Create an AWS account and set up your billing information. 2. Follow the tutorial 'Getting Started with Amazon EC2' to launch your first EC2 instance. 3. Choose an appropriate Amazon Machine Image (AMI) and instance type. 4. Configure security groups to allow HTTP and SSH access. 5.
